Description: Runs one glaze line on a rotating shift. Works closely with two others and hands over to the next shift. Accuracy and calm matter more than speed.
Leads a team of six across two lines. Plans the shift and handles surprises. Sets the tone for the whole floor.
Turns trade orders into weekly production plans. Talks to sales and the floor every day. Needs to see problems before they arrive.
Checks finished tiles against the spec and signs off batches. Works alone for long stretches and writes the defect log.
